behavior: Opaque owner registers and captures WSK, owns listener and per-generation policy/receipt history.
Stop disarms policy and admission under one authority lock.
Binding drain and host caller join precede listener close, provider release and deregistration.
A failed listener close quarantines the owner/provider; a separate host callback-return barrier is required before owner free.
limits: Startup socket creation and bind are unbounded completion waits at PASSIVE_LEVEL.
Host join and callback-return barriers are contracts; product wiring and runtime proof remain open.
WskSocket OwningProcess controls bind security/address sharing, not a proven WFP transport target identity.
